claims.text: Overall Orange Flood in China (event id 1104081, episode 7, reporting window 31 Jul 2026 01:00 UTC to 13 Aug 2026 01:00 UTC). Heavy rain associated with Typhoon Dolphin caused flooding in Hubei Province, China, from 11 August 2026.

GDACS event API data for FL 1104081: displaced total 237338, with 215,600 people evacuated in Shanghai, China (8-10 August 2026) as the single largest component, and further evacuations totaling over 238,000 across Shaanxi, Hubei, Zhejiang and Jiangsu combined. Event location centroid: latitude 32.2656, longitude 111.6474. Date range 2026-07-31T01:00:00 to 2026-08-13T01:00:00.

Re-checked 14 August 2026: GDACS's event data for FL 1104081 confirms episode 7 (31 July - 13 August 2026 reporting window) remains the latest episode, with the combined 237,338-person evacuation total unchanged. No allowlisted source has published a confirmed death toll or declared the flooding contained.

GDACS's flood report (event FL-2026-000148-CHN, id 1104081) as of 16 August 2026 rates the event an Orange alert (medium humanitarian impact) centered on Henan Province flooding driven by the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin, with 302,931 people displaced and 0 deaths recorded; China's Ministry of Emergency Management dispatched 13 emergency drainage teams to Zhoukou city for urban waterlogging relief.

GDACS's flood report for event FL-2026-000148-CHN (episode 9, reporting window now 31 July - 16 August 2026) records the event's first confirmed death and missing persons: 1 person killed and 3 people missing after a residential building collapsed in a debris flow in Heping Town, Changxing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province. The combined displacement total remains 302,931 people evacuated across Hubei, Henan, Shaanxi, Shanghai, Zhejiang and Jiangsu; overall alert level remains Orange (medium humanitarian impact).

Re-checked 18 August 2026: direct fetch of GDACS's event report for FL 1104081 reconfirms episode 9 (reporting window 31 Jul - 16 Aug 2026) remains the latest episode, with Orange alert level, 302,931 people displaced, and 1 death / 3 missing in Zhejiang Province all unchanged from the prior check.

description: Heavy rain associated with Typhoon Dolphin triggered severe flooding across multiple central and eastern Chinese provinces beginning 31 July 2026, with the heaviest impacts from around 11 August 2026 as the storm's remnant moisture swelled rivers and triggered a levee breach in Hubei Province. GDACS tracks the event (GLIDE FL-2026-000148-CHN, event id 1104081) as a distinct flood event from the already-resolved Guangxi/Hunan flooding in July and the separately-tracked Jilin flooding, assessing it as an overall Orange alert. As of GDACS's episode 7 update (reporting window 31 July - 13 August 2026), a combined 237,338 people have been evacuated across Hubei, Henan, Shaanxi, Shanghai, Zhejiang and Jiangsu, with the single largest evacuation -- 215,600 people -- in Shanghai between 8-10 August 2026. No allowlisted source has published a confirmed death toll or declared the flooding contained. Re-checked 14 August 2026: GDACS's episode 7 report remains the latest, with the combined 237,338-person evacuation total unchanged; no allowlisted source has published a confirmed death toll or declared the flooding contained. Re-checked 15 August 2026: GDACS's episode 8 update (31 July - 13 August 2026 reporting window) raises the combined evacuation total to 302,931 people (up from 237,338 in episode 7), still Overall Orange alert with a death toll of 0 recorded. No allowlisted source has published a confirmed death toll or declared the flooding contained. Re-checked 16 August 2026: GDACS still rates the event Orange (medium impact) with 302,931 displaced and 0 deaths recorded; China's Ministry of Emergency Management has dispatched 13 emergency drainage teams to Zhoukou city, Henan, for urban waterlogging relief. Re-checked 17 August 2026: GDACS's episode 9 update (reporting window extended to 31 July - 16 August 2026) records the event's first confirmed death and missing persons -- 1 person killed and 3 people missing after a residential building collapsed in a debris flow in Heping Town, Changxing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province -- while the combined displacement total remains unchanged at 302,931 people across Hubei, Henan, Shaanxi, Shanghai, Zhejiang and Jiangsu; the overall alert level remains Orange. Re-checked 18 August 2026: direct fetch of GDACS's event report for FL 1104081 reconfirms episode 9 remains the latest episode (reporting window 31 July - 16 August 2026), with the Orange alert level, the 302,931-person displacement total, and the 1 death / 3 missing Zhejiang debris-flow figures all unchanged; a targeted web search found no newer episode and no updated casualty count.
